---
title: "Projects"
---

Our projects connect fundamental research in perception and AI with practical autonomous-system and transportation applications.

## Multimodal Perception

Robust perception and sensor fusion using radar, cameras, LiDAR, and complementary sensing modalities.

## Reliable Autonomous Systems

Methods for improving reliability, calibration, uncertainty awareness, and decision-making in autonomous platforms.

## AI for Transportation and Robotics

Applied AI for intelligent transportation systems, roadway safety, mobile robotics, and field-deployed sensing.
